meta.title: Share vs Replicate vs Federate: Pick by Access Pattern, Not Habit

views.label: Zero copy, lowest cost
views.note: Consumers run their own workloads against live data with no pipeline to maintain.

views.label: Local copy beats repeated cross-cloud reads
views.note: Heavy or frequent querying justifies the cost of a local Deep Clone kept warm with CDF.

views.label: Never register a shared table twice
views.note: Registering the same shared table as external in more than one metastore desyncs schema and commits under multi-writer load.

cards.title: Share when consumers run their own workloads
items: Delta Sharing reads live data directly from provider storage via short-lived tokens -- no copy, no pipeline
Databricks-to-Databricks, open protocol, or customer-managed OSS server -- pick per recipient capability

cards.title: Replicate when local reads dominate
items: Deep Clone plus Delta Change Data Feed limits egress to the incremental refresh, not the full table
Federation is a bridge for exploration, not a destination -- avoid large unfiltered remote joins

cards.title: Never dual-register a shared table
items: Registering the same shared table as external in more than one metastore desyncs schema and commits under multi-writer load
Choose one: share it (Delta Sharing) or replicate it (Deep Clone) -- never both for the same table
